description: Calculation engine state when called with an incomplete profile. The engine must never run without a complete profile (validated input + resolved geo/timezone).

data.reasonEngineNotCalled: GATE 1b (geo/timezone) never passed; profile missing longitude, timezone, and full birth details
data.notes: The legacy renderer called getCanonicalJyotishSnapshot() directly without running through the canonical model adapter. This bypassed all validation gates.
